essence: A MOTION effect: procedurally shakes/displaces the whole frame over time — positional jitter plus optional zoom-pulse and rotational wobble, driven by an Amplitude (magnitude) and Speed (rate). Produces handheld / impact / earthquake / rhythm-hit camera motion. Post Scale overscans the frame so the shake doesn't reveal black edges. Has a Beat Reactor to drive the shake from an audio layer.
manifests_as: the whole frame jitters/displaces (+ optional zoom & rotate wobble) animated over time. A STILL only shows ONE frozen displaced/scaled frame — the shake itself is temporal and cannot be seen in a single frame (static-probe limitation).

key_levers.name: Amplitude
key_levers.effect: MASTER shake magnitude — overall displacement amount. 0 = no shake; scales everything (translation/scale/rotation). Keyframe it to spike-then-decay for an impact hit. Probe-confirmed it displaces the frame at high values.

key_levers.name: Speed
key_levers.effect: frequency/rate of the shake — how fast the frame jitters. Low = slow lazy sway, high = frantic rattle.

key_levers.name: Translation
key_levers.effect: amount of POSITIONAL (X/Y) shake — the core handheld jitter component.

key_levers.name: Translation X / Y
key_levers.effect: per-axis weighting of the positional shake (paired Y = BCC_CAMERASHAKE-1015). Set Y to 0 for a horizontal-only rattle, X to 0 for vertical-only.

key_levers.name: Scale
key_levers.effect: zoom-PULSE shake — adds punchy in/out scale jitter (0 = none). Great for impact hits.

key_levers.name: Rotation
key_levers.effect: rotational WOBBLE amount (0 = none) — tilts/rolls the frame as it shakes.

key_levers.name: Randomize
key_levers.effect: seed/variation of the shake pattern — change to get a different random motion of the same character.

key_levers.name: Post Scale
key_levers.effect: overscan — pre-scales the frame up so the translation/rotation shake doesn't reveal empty/black edges. Raise if edges show during a big shake. Probe-confirmed hides edges at 130.

key_levers.name: Edge Mode
key_levers.effect: how any edges revealed by the shake are filled (repeat / reflect / transparent / etc).

enums_to_verify.Beat Reactor (BCC_CAMERASHAKE-8001 enabl: drives the shake from an audio layer's amplitude — the beat-synced-shake path; Audio Samplers A/B/C map bands to shake params
enums_to_verify.Motion Blur (BCC_CAMERASHAKE-1006 enable: adds directional motion blur to the shake for realism

config_recipes.subtle handheld: Amplitude 20-50, Translation 2-6, Speed 60-120, Rotation 2-5, Post Scale 105-110
config_recipes.impact / hit shake: Amplitude 300-600, Speed 300-600, Translation 15-30, Scale 10-20 — keyframe Amplitude to spike on the frame then decay to 0
config_recipes.earthquake / heavy rumble: Amplitude 600-1000, Scale 10-30, Rotation 10-30, Speed 400+, Post Scale 120-140
config_recipes.beat-synced: enable Beat Reactor, pick the audio layer, map an Audio Sampler to Amplitude/Scale

reasoning_hooks.black edges showing during the shake: raise Post Scale (overscan) and/or check Edge Mode
reasoning_hooks.shake only left-right (or up-down): set Translation Y 0 (or X 0) and raise the other
reasoning_hooks.make it react to the music: enable Beat Reactor + select the audio layer

grounding: introspect card (159 leaf params, full SEMANTIC names + ranges — cards/BCC_CAMERASHAKE.json; the live shake dials are the BCC_CAMERASHAKE-10xx group) + model prior on BCC Camera Shake + a 2-frame STATIC confirm (introspect/frames/ess_shake_amp0 vs ess_shake_ampMax: the frame is clearly displaced/scaled at high Amplitude, Post Scale hides edges). NOTE: a static probe cannot show the temporal shake motion — Amplitude/Speed/frequency behaviour is grounded on names + model prior, only frame displacement was visually verified. Confidence: high on the lever identities; the shake dynamics are inferred (motion effect).
_method: introspect + static confirm + synth (motion effect — probe intentionally minimal)
